# A3.03 Baseline UI layout plan

## Owner
A3

## Stage
Plan

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-02

## Input (reads)
UI baseline or extracted design, screen inventory

## Steps
1. For each screen write a text wireframe: regions, primary action, order of content.
2. Confirm one primary action per screen.
3. Label PROPOSED where the source is silent

## Output (writes)
Layout plan per screen

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/design/<ID>/layout-plan.md`

## Verification
Each screen has exactly one primary action

## Checkpoints raised
- none
